title: Infra Plan Readback
description: Stops a Terraform or OpenTofu apply from quietly destroying data by reading the `terraform show -json` plan back as create, update, replace and destroy counts, putting destroys and replacements of databases, buckets, volumes and keys first with the attribute that forces each replacement (before → after, sensitive values hidden), whether the old one goes before its replacement exists and what force_destroy or skip_final_snapshot will do, flagging production workspaces and a var.environment that says production when the workspace doesn't, and keeping Apply locked until each data loss is acknowledged and, in production, the workspace name is typed.
stops: Production database destroyed by terraform apply
